[1/1] plan: replace the O(n!) permutation enumeration in _first_of_deadline_tour with an exact bitmask dynamic program (same max-collected/earliest-finish/tie-break objective), raise the item cap from 7 to 12, re-baseline the deadline tests, add 8-12 item measurements against the tour ablation, and record ADR-196 plus cycle notes.

impact_assessment.why: ADR-195's schedule is exact but exponential: at 8+ items it falls back to the shortest tour and loses items, so the shipped capability stops exactly where DeadlineWorld can still be measured.
impact_assessment.benefits: Exact deadline scheduling scales to 12 items; 4/5/6-item behavior stays byte-identical; the ablation becomes a sharper negative control at larger counts.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: internal helper and cap constant only, no CLI or default change; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: probe readout extends to larger item counts; regression: standing T1/T2/T3 pins must stay byte-identical.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first equivalence tests against brute force on seeded layouts up to 7 items, explicit 8-12 item collection tests, the full suite and aikit 5/5.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] plan: replace the factorial permutation enumeration in _first_of_best_tour and _tour_audit with an exact O(n^2 2^n) subset DP preserving the lexicographic first-shortest-tour tie-break; pin equivalence on 2-4 items and bounded time at 10-12 items; make evals.schedule_scaling fast and honest about the 12-item world cap; record ADR-197.

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 202 raised the deadline cap to 12 items but the shortest-tour ablation still enumerates every permutation of the remaining items, so 10-12 item episodes stall for minutes and the new scaling eval cannot finish.
impact_assessment.benefits: The ablation and its tour audit scale to 12 items with the exact same first-cell and tie verdicts; the scaling eval completes and reports the real shipped-vs-ablation numbers at 8-12 items.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: internal helpers only, no CLI or default change; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: tour readout must stay byte-identical; regression: all standing forage pins and tour-audit tests must pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: brute-force equivalence tests on 2-4 item layouts, a bounded-time test at 10-12 items, the full suite and aikit 5/5.
